title: Supreme Court Stays Demolitions Of Petitioners' Structures Near Rajasthan Indo-Pak Border For 2 Weeks, Asks Them To Move HC
description: The Supreme Court on Friday (July 17) halted the demolitions of structures belonging to the petitioners near the India-Pakistan border in Rajasthan for two weeks, while asking the affected parties to approach the division bench of the Rajasthan High Court for relief. A bench comprising Justice PS Narasimha and Justice Alok Aradhe refused to entertain the writ petition filed by eight petitioners, and asked them to file intra-court appeal in the Rajasthan High Court.
